The Fund does not have any fixed rate financial instrument at fair value through profit or loss. Therefore, the Fund is not exposed to fair value changes for fixed rate instruments. However, the bank and term deposit at variable rates expose the Fund to fluctuations in cash flow due to change in market profit rates.
